subject.title: ci: defer macOS tests for draft pull requests

question: Should code-changing draft pull requests report an aggregate-green deferred state and postpone macOS Swift shards until they become ready for review?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but the balance between runner capacity, early macOS feedback, and the meaning of a successful aggregate check is an intentional repository policy choice.

options.title: Adopt draft deferral
options.body: Accept the deferred aggregate state for drafts and require the fresh ready-for-review macOS run to pass before merge.

options.title: Keep macOS checks on drafts
options.body: Retain the current policy so every code-changing draft synchronization consumes macOS runners and receives immediate platform validation.

recommendation.title: Adopt draft deferral
recommendation.body: Accept the deferred aggregate state for drafts and require the fresh ready-for-review macOS run to pass before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the strongest available owner for CI-capacity and branch-gate policy.
